hindi: कृपया अभी कार्रवाई करें: कृपया मुझे तुरंत एक अधिकारी से जोड़ें।। कृपया मुझे अनदेखा न करें।
odia: ଦୟାକରି ଏବେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରନ୍ତୁ: ଦୟାକରି ମୋତେ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଜଣେ ଅଧିକାରୀଙ୍କ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।। ଦୟାକରି ମୋତେ ଅଣଦେଖା କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
sambalpuri: Ebe turant katha suna: Babu/officer sanghe katha karao turant mote anadekha nai kara.
santali: Nita ge kami pe: Daya kate kamin/officer sang te ropor ochoying pe aalo pe bageana.
kui: Eebe turat vasa: Officer/babu sanghe katha karayatu turat aanki bagedu aatu.
desia: Ebe turant katha suna: Officer/babu sanghe katha koraa turant muke anadekha nai kora.
notes: Multilingual emergency phrase including native Sambalpuri (Kosli), Santali, Kui (Kandha), and Desia (Koraput) dialect variations.

english: I need immediate help: Please connect me to an officer immediately I need someone to help.
hindi: मुझे तुरंत मदद चाहिए: कृपया मुझे तुरंत एक अधिकारी से जोड़ें।। मुझे किसी की मदद चाहिए।
odia: ମୋତେ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଦରକାର: ଦୟାକରି ମୋତେ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଜଣେ ଅଧିକାରୀଙ୍କ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।। ମୋତେ କାହାରୋ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଦରକାର।
sambalpuri: Turant sahajya darkar: Babu/officer sanghe katha karao turant kahari madat pathao.
santali: Turat banchao darkar: Daya kate kamin/officer sang te ropor ochoying pe jahay hohoako pe.
kui: Turat saaha lohe: Officer/babu sanghe katha karayatu turat eeheki madat poyatu.
desia: Turant sahajya darkar: Officer/babu sanghe katha koraa turant karike madat pathaa.
notes: Multilingual emergency phrase including native Sambalpuri (Kosli), Santali, Kui (Kandha), and Desia (Koraput) dialect variations.

english: For my safety, Please connect me to an officer immediately Please take this seriously.
hindi: मेरी सुरक्षा के लिए, कृपया मुझे तुरंत एक अधिकारी से जोड़ें।। कृपया इसे गंभीरता से लें।
odia: ମୋ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ, ଦୟାକରି ମୋତେ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଜଣେ ଅଧିକାରୀଙ୍କ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।। ଦୟାକରି ଏହାକୁ ଗମ୍ଭୀରତାର ସହ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
sambalpuri: Mor surakshya lagi, Babu/officer sanghe katha karao turant eha ke gambhira hisabe nia.
santali: Ingak suraksha lagi, Daya kate kamin/officer sang te ropor ochoying pe aadi jaruri kana.
kui: Aani surakshya lagi, Officer/babu sanghe katha karayatu turat eeheke gambhira hisabe gihmu.
desia: Mor surakshya lagi, Officer/babu sanghe katha koraa turant eita ke gambhira kori nia.
notes: Multilingual emergency phrase including native Sambalpuri (Kosli), Santali, Kui (Kandha), and Desia (Koraput) dialect variations.
